blurr.title: Document Blur Tool
blurr.intro: A document blur tool that lets you search and locate content in PDF documents, then blur it with customizable intensity and page range
blurr.uploadText: Click to Select a PDF Document
blurr.searchPlaceholder: Enter keywords to search page content...

blurr.problem2: Simplify tedious manual operations, improving work efficiency and accuracy.
blurr.problem3: No professional software installation required; use it online anytime, anywhere.

blurr.featureOnline: Online Processing: All operations run in your browser; no downloads or installation required.

blurr.usageUpload2: File Limit: PDF files up to 100MB are supported.
blurr.usageUpload3: Auto Parse: After upload, the system automatically parses the PDF and shows previews of all pages.

blurr.usageBlur3: Custom Pages: When custom pages is selected, enter page numbers separated by commas or as ranges (e.g. 1,3,5-8).
blurr.usageBlur4: Content Search: Enter keywords to search text in the PDF and quickly locate relevant pages.

blurr.usagePage2: Select Pages: Click a page thumbnail to select or deselect that page.
blurr.usagePage3: Select All / Deselect All: Use the buttons to quickly select or deselect all pages.
blurr.usagePage4: Zoom In: Click a page thumbnail to view its details in an enlarged view.

blurr.usageProcess2: View Progress: A progress bar and percentage are shown during processing.
blurr.usageProcess3: Download Result: After processing, click the "Download Blurred PDF" button to save the result.
blurr.noteSecurity1: All processing is done entirely in your local browser; data is never uploaded to any server.
blurr.noteSecurity2: Avoid processing documents containing sensitive information on public devices.

blurr.noteProcess2: Processing large files may take a while; please be patient.
blurr.noteProcess3: Download the result promptly after processing; the result is lost when the page is closed.
blurr.noteFormat2: Encrypted or corrupted PDF files may not be processed.
blurr.noteFormat3: Scanned PDFs may not have recognizable text content.
blurr.noteEffect1: Blurring affects the entire page content, including text and images.
blurr.noteEffect2: A blur intensity of 3-5px is recommended; higher values may make page content unrecognizable.
blurr.noteEffect3: The processed PDF file size may increase.
blurr.noteFaq1: Upload failed: Check that the file is a valid PDF and within the size limit.
blurr.noteFaq2: Slow processing: Large or multi-page PDFs take longer to process; please wait.
blurr.noteFaq3: Download failed: Check browser download permissions and try another browser.
blurr.noteFaq4: Page display issues: Some PDF formats may not render correctly; try opening with another PDF reader.
